message: There is water coming through the ceiling. I tried calling and nobody answered.
I smell gas in the kitchen, it's pretty strong.
My smoke detector is going off and I can smell smoke near the stove.
The kitchen faucet has been dripping for a few days, not urgent.
Bathroom light bulb burned out, could someone replace it when convenient.
No heat in the apartment since this morning, it's freezing.
The front door hinge is squeaking loudly.
There's sewage backing up into the bathtub.
Power went out in half the unit, breaker won't reset.
The toilet keeps running after flushing, wastes water.
Screen door off its track, minor repair whenever.
There's a strange burning smell coming from the electrical panel.
My apartment flooded overnight, water is an inch deep in the hallway.
Kind of a weird message, not sure how to describe it, something feels off with the unit but I can't tell what.
